unique_context: LDOE's 'Artificial Intelligence in Louisiana Schools' (Aug 28, 2024) is advisory, meant as the foundation for local policies, and organizes classroom use into tiers from AI-Empowered to AI-Prohibited. The legislature has so far acted around the edges: HR 249 (2026, adopted) asks BESE to fold AI into content standards; HB 1149 (2026) would require AI instruction in grades 6-12; HB 119 (2026, enacted) is a deepfake-image crime law that also requires schools to teach the consequences from grade 6, with LDOE developing the materials.
notes: Superintendent Cade Brumley on the release: 'As the impact of artificial intelligence grows, it's important we provide information on effective and safe utilization.' LDOE also publishes an 'AI for Leaders' companion.
